plank.deflection: 2-segment polyline: kink under the occupant, depth D_max(load)*sin(pi*u); empty: damped spring 2 px*exp(-dt/0.25)*cos(2pi*3*dt) after each step-off

liana.rule: the plank occupant holds it with exactly one hand; under the hand the line is pulled to the hand point (sag follows the hand)

water.note: level(t) = 416 - min(0.5 t, 18) in P2 px, t = version-local seconds; L reaches +18 at 36 s, E +15 at 30 s

shoe_drift.path: Catmull-Rom through (830,404) (640,398) (430,406) (214,410), eased in time; holds at the plank foot after arrive_dt

coords: P2 plane, wide framing, picture px (800x540), y down; film t = L local + 2.0, E local + 39.5
